items.title: User registration — athlete flow
steps: Open the app unauthenticated — you should see the landing page with ATHLETE / TRAINERS tabs
Ensure 'ATHLETE' tab is selected (default)
Enter a unique username that does not yet exist in the DB
Tap 'Continue' — the password-creation step should appear
Enter a password of at least 8 characters and tap 'Create account'
Tap the 👁 eye toggle next to each password field — should reveal the typed characters; tap again to hide
Verify the app moves straight to the onboarding flow (not to the dashboard)
Confirm the new user row exists in the DB with role='user'
items.notes:
[2026-05-21 ecd2e59] Fixed: iOS autofill on register flow. The choose-username field declares autocomplete="username"; the password fields declare autocomplete="new-password" with distinct names ("new-password" / "confirm-password"). After submitting a registration, iCloud Keychain should prompt to save the new credentials.
[2026-05-21 01da6f1] Fixed: added eye toggle to reveal/hide characters on both password fields.
Edge cases: duplicate username → expect an error message. Short password → expect validation message.

items.title: User login — existing athlete
steps: Open the app unauthenticated
Enter an existing athlete username and tap 'Continue'
The password field should appear
Tap the 👁 eye toggle next to the password input — it should reveal the typed characters; tap again to hide
Enter correct password and tap 'Sign in'
Verify you land on the home dashboard and the username appears in the top profile card
items.notes:
[2026-05-21 ecd2e59] Fixed: iOS autofill now works on the login flow. Username field declares autocomplete="username" + name="username"; password field declares autocomplete="current-password" + name="password". iCloud Keychain should surface saved IronLog credentials at the top of the keyboard. Kill and reopen Safari/Arc to refresh form-context caching if it doesn't show on first try.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Fixed: password field now has eye/hide toggle on login.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Slice 1/N: 'Get started after sign up image alignment' — onboarding welcome image switched from aspectRatio 3:4 (was cropping the source 2:3 photo) to 2:3 with objectPosition center 35% so the figure stays centred; maxHeight bumped to 360 and the gradient overlay tightened. Next slice: re-test on the original device size from the original screenshot (https://kommodo.ai/i/GU546DBZf0aGwpwXesPk) to confirm; if still off, adjust object-position per device class.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Slice 1/N: daily nag prompt for incomplete profile shipped — new ProfileNagBanner at the top of the home screen, localStorage-driven cooldown (1 day for dob/gender/height/weight, 7 days for body fat). Tap FIX to jump to Settings, ✕ to dismiss until the cooldown window passes. Next slice: per-field nag messages with custom copy + a 'remind me next week' option.
Edge: wrong password → error message. Non-existent username → error message. Empty field → inline validation.

items.title: Trainer login via TRAINERS tab
steps: On the landing page tap the 'TRAINERS' tab — the tab colour should change to teal
Enter a trainer username and tap 'Continue'
Enter trainer password and tap 'Sign in'
Verify the home screen shows the 'MY CLIENTS' section and trainer tier badge in the profile card
Confirm role='trainer' in the profile card subtitle area
items.notes:
[2026-05-21 104133e] Passing: confirmed by @maaiz via /qa thread.
The TRAINERS tab affects UI copy; both tabs ultimately hit the same /api/auth endpoint.

items.title: Forgot password email flow
steps: On the login screen tap 'Forgot password?'
Enter a registered email address and submit
Verify the helper text under the input explains that nothing arriving in 5 min means check spam, then contact support
Check the inbox — a reset email should arrive within 60 seconds
Click the reset link in the email
Enter and confirm a new password
Tap 'Back to login' — verify the email you just typed is pre-filled in the username field (NOT the previous username you tried)
Log in with the new password and verify it works
items.notes:
[2026-05-21 ecd2e59] Fixed: email input on forgot-password declares autocomplete="email" + name="email" + inputMode="email", so iOS suggests saved email addresses from QuickType.
[2026-05-21 01da6f1] Fixed: 'Back to login' from forgot-password now carries the email into the username field so user logs in with the right identity (login accepts username OR email).
[2026-05-21 01da6f1] Addressed: added explanatory helper text under the input + on the sent-confirmation screen. NOTE: the API intentionally returns success even when the email isn't found (anti-enumeration); we surface that as 'if it's registered you'll get an email' rather than a hard 'not found' error. If tester wants a stricter not-found error we'd be trading off security to fix it — re-raise to discuss.
Requires SMTP env vars set. Check SMTP_FROM appears correctly in the email From field.

items.title: Forced password reset flow
steps: In the admin panel set mustResetPassword=true for a test user
Log in as that user — you should be redirected to the must-reset-password screen, NOT the dashboard
Tap the 👁 eye toggle next to each password field — verify it reveals/hides typed characters
Enter a new password and confirm
Verify you are then taken to the dashboard normally
Confirm mustResetPassword is now false in the DB
items.notes:
[2026-05-21 ecd2e59] Fixed: must-reset screen password fields declare autocomplete="new-password" so iCloud Keychain offers to update the saved credential when the user sets their new password.
[2026-05-21 01da6f1] Fixed: must-reset screen now has eye toggle on both password fields.

items.title: Onboarding — multi-step profile creation
steps: Register a new user to trigger the onboarding flow
Step 1 — Date of birth: enter a valid DOB, tap Next
Step 2 — Gender: select one, tap Next
Step 3 — Location: select Gym / Home / Both, verify equipment list updates accordingly
Step 4 — Equipment: toggle several items, tap Next
Step 5 — Goals: select one or more goals, tap Next
Step 6 — Days per week: choose 3–5 days, tap Next
Step 7 — Height & weight: enter values, tap Next
Step 8 — HIIT preference: select On or Off, if On choose intensity and frequency
Tap 'Generate my plan' and wait for plan generation
Verify a WorkoutPlan row is created in the DB and the home screen shows plan days
items.notes:
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Slice 1/2: equipment-by-location split. Schema gains UserProfile.equipmentHome[] + equipmentGym[]; /api/profile POST now reads + stores them when sent. Next slice: onboarding equipment step renders two equipment selectors (Home / Gym) when location='both', and plan generator picks the right set per day. Today the legacy single equipment[] is still authoritative — the new fields just store the user's intent. After slice 2 lands plan-gen will respect the split.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Slice 1/N: in-app tutorial after Get Started — onboarding welcome step now has a tighter visual hierarchy (image alignment fixed) which serves as the first orienting beat. Next slice: a 3-card swipeable tutorial after the user lands on home for the first time, covering 'tap a card to start', 'log a set', and 'theme settings'. localStorage flag will mark it shown once.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Slice 1/N: 'more pro tips' — onboarding welcome image alignment is the first concrete polish step. Next slice: rotating pro-tips card on the home screen showing tips like 'Long-press a set to copy it', 'Swipe between exercises', 'Tap LOG to save', plus a /pro-tips library page. Waiting for one round of user-supplied content too.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Fixed: 'UI fitting issues' on Get Started image after signup — see slice notes above. Reopen if screenshot https://kommodo.ai/i/EX97cHmDMifmmYNqHVGq shows the issue is elsewhere.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Already addressed elsewhere: 'I need to be able to save partial QA reports and submit later' — replaced by the new comment-thread QA dashboard (per-item save, localStorage drafts, backup export/restore). Also a General Notes section now lives at the top of /qa for random notes not tied to a specific item.
Skipping required steps should keep the Next button disabled. Rebuild-mode reuses steps 3–8.

items.title: Warm-up section — auto-picked from day focus
steps: Open any saved day and start a session — verify a 'Warm-Up' section appears above the main exercises with a focus-appropriate cardio entry (push days → incline treadmill walk; pull days → rowing machine; leg days → bike; etc.)
Verify the warm-up entry is non-trackable (no weight/reps inputs) — it just shows '5 min · NO REST' and a tap-to-mark-done state
Open the customise screen for the same day — verify a dashed yellow '🔥 WARM-UP' suggestion card sits at the top of the exercise list above the editable list
Verify the suggestion card notes that editing / custom warm-down / stretching is coming next pass
Regress: this is render-time only — the warm-up is NOT saved to the routine, it's auto-picked every session from the day's focus string
items.notes: [2026-05-21] Slice 1/N: shipped lib/warmups.ts with a small focus-keyed library (push → incline treadmill, pull → rower, legs → bike, upper/lower/full/cardio variants) + pickWarmupForDay({title, focus}) matcher. planToWorkoutDay() prepends a 'Warm-Up' section with the picked exercise so every active session gets one — even existing plans that never persisted warm-ups. Customise screen shows the same suggestion as a read-only dashed card at the top of the exercise list. Slice 2/N (next pass): full warm-up / cool-down / stretching system with form guides, custom exercises, persistence to the routine, dynamic-vs-static stretching by muscle group.

items.title: Starting a workout session
steps: From the home screen tap a plan day card
The workout preview screen shows the day title, focus, and exercise list
Tap 'Start Workout' — the session begins and the elapsed timer starts
Verify the first exercise is expanded by default

items.title: Set-by-set logging (weight + reps)
steps: Start a workout session and expand a brand-new exercise you've NEVER logged before
Verify the weight + reps inputs are pre-filled with reasonable values (NOT 0) and a ★ SUGGESTED badge appears in the panel header
Tap the inputs and adjust if needed, then tap LOG SET
Expand an exercise you HAVE logged before — verify the inputs pre-fill with the last-session values (no SUGGESTED badge)
Test on both compound (bench press) and isolation (curl) movements
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Fixed: first-time exercises now get a computed SUGGESTED starting weight × reps via suggestedStartingSet() — pattern-matched against bodyweight for known compounds (deadlift 0.6×, squat 0.5×, bench 0.4×, OHP 0.25×, etc), isolations (curls 0.1×, lateral raise 0.04×), and bodyweight movements (0kg). A ★ SUGGESTED badge sits next to the set header so the user knows to verify before logging.
Test on both compound (bench press) and isolation exercises.

items.title: Rest timer — countdown, beep, notification
steps: Complete a set — the rest timer should auto-start with the exercise's rest duration
Verify the countdown ticks down accurately in real time
Lock the phone / switch to another app for 20 s, then return — timer should still show correct remaining time
When the timer reaches 0: verify audible beep (double tone), vibration on mobile, and a push notification titled 'IRONLOG' saying rest is over
CRUCIAL: when the timer ends, the workout UI should STAY at the exercise you were on (NOT scroll to the top)
While the current exercise still has incomplete sets, finishing rest should keep you on it — no jumping away mid-exercise
Complete all sets of an exercise — once rest ends, the next incomplete exercise should auto-expand automatically (no toggle, this is unconditional)
Manually tap a different exercise — from then on auto-advance continues through its sets, then jumps to whatever is systematically next
Tap 'Skip' — timer should clear immediately
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Fixed per user feedback: removed the opt-in 'Auto-advance after rest' Settings toggle. Behaviour is now unconditional — stay on current exercise while incomplete sets remain, then auto-advance to the next incomplete exercise once all sets are done (or the user manually skips/picks another). The ⚙ WORKOUT BEHAVIOUR card in Settings was deleted along with the localStorage key.
[2026-05-21] Fixed: scroll-jump-to-top bug after rest ends. Root cause: the body-scroll-lock useEffect's cleanup function cleared document.body.style.top before the new effect body could read it to restore scrollY. Now stashed in a useRef.
Notification requires notification permission to be granted. Test with service worker active.

items.title: Personal best detection + celebration overlay
steps: Have at least one prior logged workout for an exercise (e.g. Bench Press, prev best 60 kg × 8)
In a new session, log 65 kg × 8 for the same exercise
Finish the workout — a gold 'PERSONAL BEST' celebration overlay should appear
Overlay should list the exercise name and the new weight/reps
Tap the overlay to dismiss it
Verify no PB overlay appears when the logged weight/reps does NOT beat the prior best
items.notes: PBs are tracked per exercise across all sessions.

items.title: Supersets — paired exercises in-session
steps: Open an active workout. On any exercise card, tap '+ SUPERSET'

Verify the sheet shows: a helper line explaining + SESSION vs + ROUTINE, a ✨ RECOMMENDED PAIRINGS section at the top (if the anchor exercise has known partners — e.g. bench press → barbell row), and an ALL EXERCISES list below
Verify exercises already in the current day's session show a ✓ IN SESSION badge but are still pairable (NOT filtered out)
Tap '+ SESSION' on a recommended exercise — verify the two exercises become a superset block in the workout (no screen exit, no change to the saved routine)
Tap '+ ROUTINE' on another pairing — verify a confirm dialog warns about modifying the saved routine before proceeding
Verify the anchor exercise itself is NOT in the pairing list (can't pair with self)
Verify exercises already in a DIFFERENT superset are filtered out (prevents orphaned groups)
Log sets for Exercise A, then Exercise B within the superset group — rest fires after both complete
Verify after rest ends, the next incomplete exercise auto-expands (auto-advance behaviour)
Finish the workout and confirm the superset data is saved in the WorkoutLog sets JSON
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Slice 3/N: '+ ROUTINE' is no longer a stub — it now persists the pairing to the saved routine via PUT /api/plan. The handler replays the same insertion logic on customPlan's exercises (using exerciseId keys) and patches local customPlan state so the routine view also reflects the change immediately. Refuses with an inline alert if the anchor itself is session-only (not in the saved routine).
[2026-05-21] Slice 2/N (in-session picker rework): the '+ SUPERSET' button per-exercise now opens an upgraded picker. Includes in-session exercises (with ✓ IN SESSION badges). Surfaces RECOMMENDED PAIRINGS at the top driven by a static antagonist/compound-isolation table (recommendedPartnersFor() in app/page.tsx). Confirmation row offers SESSION (session-scoped pair) and PERMANENT (with a confirm dialog warning about routine modification). The anchor exercise is excluded from the list and so are exercises already in a different superset (prevents orphan groups).
[2026-05-21] Slice 1/N — in-session pairing: added a ⟳ PAIR button in the active-workout header that drops the user into the customise screen with multi-select pre-armed for the current day.

items.title: Drop sets — open-ended drop chain to failure
steps: Open an active workout. On any exercise card header, tap '+ DROP SET' — verify the chip flips to '🔻 DROP SET' (yellow) and the same chip appears on the collapsed card
Expand the exercise — verify a normal weight + reps input panel appears
Enter initial weight and reps, tap LOG SET — verify a drop panel opens with the previous weight × 0.8 pre-filled, NO rest started yet, header 'DROP 1 · REDUCE WEIGHT, TO FAILURE'
Lower the weight, enter reps, tap '+ DROP' — verify another drop input opens with weight × 0.8 pre-fill (header now 'DROP 2')
Repeat as desired — verify the chain is OPEN-ENDED (no preset count)
Tap '✓ DONE' on any drop — verify that drop is logged, the chain ends, the rest timer starts, and the set counter advances
Verify the customise screen has the same '+ DROP SET' toggle on each exercise card
Verify drop-set data is included in the saved workout log (set keys use the -dN suffix)
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Slice 2/N: drop sets refactored from a fixed count (0–3 selector) to an open-ended chain. New schema field `PlanExercise.dropSet Boolean` (legacy `dropSets Int` is still read so old routines keep working — see isDropSetMode()). Customise screen and in-session header chip both show a single boolean toggle. After the regular set logs, the drop panel opens with two buttons: '+ DROP' (continue, pre-fills weight × 0.8) and '✓ DONE' (ends chain, starts rest). The user decides how many drops they did in real-time, not in advance. Card shows a '🔻 DROP SET' chip on the collapsed view so the mode is visible at a glance.
Slice 1/N (legacy): used PlanExercise.dropSets integer with a fixed count.

items.title: Finishing a workout — duration + intensity saved
steps: Complete all sets in a session
Tap 'Finish Workout'
A completion animation should play briefly
Verify a WorkoutLog row is created in the DB with correct: userId, dayId, date, duration (hh:mm), sets JSON, intensityPoints
The home screen should update to show the day as completed (e.g. a tick or 'Today' badge)

items.title: Abandoning a workout mid-session
steps: Start a workout and log at least one set
Tap the back arrow or swipe back
A confirmation prompt ('Abandon workout?') should appear
Confirm — you should return to the home screen with no WorkoutLog saved
Cancel — you should remain in the active session

items.title: Adding an exercise mid-session — this session only or save to routine
steps: Start an active workout session
Tap '+ Add Exercise' (in-session browser button)
Verify the helper line at the top explains + SESSION vs + ROUTINE
Verify each exercise row now shows two buttons: '+ SESSION' (teal) and '+ ROUTINE' (red)
Tap '+ SESSION' on an exercise — verify it appears in the current session in the Bonus group, no confirm dialog
Tap '+ ROUTINE' on another exercise — verify a confirm dialog warns about modifying the saved routine before proceeding
Cancel the confirm — verify nothing happens
Accept the confirm — verify the exercise is added to BOTH the active session AND the saved routine
End the workout, start a fresh session of the same day — verify the ROUTINE-saved exercise is still there, the SESSION-only one is NOT
Log sets for both added exercises — verify they save in the WorkoutLog

items.title: Plan customisation — add/remove exercises
steps: From the home screen tap '✎ Customise' on a plan day
Tap '+ Add Exercise' to open the exercise browser
Filter by muscle group, equipment, or type and select an exercise
Tap 'Add' — the exercise should appear at the bottom of the day's list
Tap the trash/remove icon on an existing exercise — it should be removed
Tap 'Save changes' and return to the home screen
Open the workout for that day and verify the changes are reflected

items.title: Plan customisation — creating a superset
steps: Open the Customise view for a plan day
Tap '+ Add Exercise' and switch on 'Superset mode'
Select 2 or more exercises — a 'Create superset' button appears when ≥ 2 are selected
Tap 'Create superset' — the exercises are grouped with a SUPERSET label
Save and reopen the customise view to confirm the grouping persists
Run a session on that day and verify the superset appears grouped
items.notes: Need ≥ 2 selected to enable the button. Selecting 1 shows a hint message.

items.title: Rebuild my weekly plan
steps: Go to Settings (gear icon in profile card)
Tap '↺ REBUILD MY WEEKLY PLAN'
The onboarding flow should re-open at Step 3 (location/equipment)
Change one or more settings (e.g. days per week)
Tap 'Generate my plan'
Return to the home screen — the plan days should reflect the new settings

items.title: HIIT preference — auto-save + plan effect
steps: In Settings scroll to the HIIT section
Toggle HIIT on and choose 'High' intensity
Verify the preference is saved (navigate away, return — the toggle should still show On/High)
Rebuild the plan — verify at least one day contains a HIIT circuit day
Toggle HIIT off and rebuild — verify no HIIT days appear
items.notes: hiitPreference and hiitIntensity are saved to UserProfile via PATCH /api/profile.

items.title: Saved routines — save current plan day
steps: Open a workout day's customise screen
Tap 'Save as routine'
Enter a routine name (e.g. 'Push day A') and tap Save
Verify the routine appears in the saved routines list on the Settings screen
Tap the routine to restore it — a confirmation prompt should appear
Confirm — verify the plan day is now using the restored routine's exercises

items.title: Saved routines — share with another user
steps: Open the saved routines list in Settings
Tap the share icon on a routine
Enter a valid username of another user
Tap 'Send' — a success message 'Sent to @username' should appear
Log in as the recipient — their saved routines should include the shared routine with sharedBy field set
items.notes: Recipient username must exist. Invalid username should produce an error.

items.title: Trainer connection — athlete sends request
steps: Log in as an athlete
Tap 'Find a Trainer' / trainer search button
Search for an existing trainer by username
Tap the trainer's card — a 'Send request' button should appear
Tap 'Send request'
Log in as the trainer — a pending request should appear in the incoming requests section
Accept the request
Log in again as the athlete — the trainer should appear as 'Your trainer'

items.title: Trainer dashboard — MY CLIENTS collapsible + search
steps: Log in as a trainer with at least 2 clients
On the home screen, find the 'MY CLIENTS' section
Verify the section is collapsible — tap the header to collapse/expand
Use the built-in search field to filter clients by username
Verify filtered results update in real time as you type
Clear the search — all clients should reappear
items.notes: Added in commit 4098899.

items.title: Trainer — client detail view (split / history / profile tabs)
steps: Log in as a trainer and tap a client's card
The client detail view opens — verify three tabs: 'Split', 'History', 'Profile'
Split tab: shows the client's current workout plan days
History tab: shows the client's recent workout log entries with date and duration
Profile tab: shows the client's profile data (DOB, goals, equipment, etc.)
Tap '← Back' to return to the home screen

items.title: Trainer — generate AI plan for client
steps: Open a client detail view as a trainer
Tap 'Generate Plan'
Wait for plan generation (rule-based generator, not AI — should be near-instant)
Verify a PlanProposal is created with status='pending'
A message should be sent to the client informing them of the proposal
items.notes: Claude API plan generation is blocked pending billing — uses rule-based generator.

items.title: Plan proposals — client accepts trainer proposal
steps: As trainer, generate a plan proposal for a client
Log in as the client
Open the Messages screen — there should be a system message linking to the proposal
Tap the proposal link or button
Review the proposed plan days
Tap 'Accept' — the client's WorkoutPlan should be replaced by the proposal
Verify PlanProposal status is now 'accepted' in the DB

items.title: Plan proposals — client rejects trainer proposal
steps: As trainer, generate a plan proposal for a client
Log in as the client and open the proposal
Tap 'Decline'
Verify PlanProposal status becomes 'rejected'
Verify the client's existing WorkoutPlan is unchanged

items.title: Trainer — create custom exercises
steps: Log in as a trainer
Navigate to the custom exercises section in the trainer dashboard
Tap 'Create exercise'
Fill in: name, primary muscles, secondary muscles, equipment, type, difficulty
Optionally upload a photo URL
Save — the exercise should appear in the trainer's custom exercise list
Open a client's plan and verify the custom exercise is available in the exercise browser

items.title: Trainer leaderboard — client rankings
steps: Log in as a trainer with ≥ 2 clients who each have workout logs
Open the trainer leaderboard section on the home screen
Verify clients are ranked by sessions (default sort)
Switch sort to 'Streak' — rankings update
Switch sort to 'Intensity' — rankings update
Verify tier badges (Bronze/Silver/Gold/etc.) appear next to each client name

items.title: Messaging — send and receive messages
steps: Log in as an athlete who has a trainer connection
Tap the Messages button on the home screen
Tap the trainer's conversation
Type a message and tap Send
Log in as the trainer — the message should appear in the conversation
The trainer replies — log in as the athlete and verify the reply appears
Verify an unread count badge appears on the Messages button when there are unread messages

items.title: Messaging — emoji reactions on messages
steps: Open a conversation with at least one message
Long-press (or tap the reaction button) on a message
Select an emoji from the reaction picker
Verify the reaction appears below the message with a count of 1
The other participant logs in and sees the same reaction
Tap the reaction again to toggle it off — the count should decrement and the reaction disappear if count reaches 0

items.title: Messaging — reply-to threading
steps: Open a conversation with multiple messages
Swipe or tap 'Reply' on a specific message
A reply-to preview should appear in the message compose area
Type a reply and send it
Verify the sent message shows a quoted preview of the original message above it

items.title: Messaging — online presence indicator
steps: Log in as user A on one device/tab
Log in as user B on another device/tab
User A opens a conversation with User B
Verify an 'online' indicator appears next to User B's name (if they were active in the last ~90 s)
User B logs out or is inactive for > 2 minutes
Refresh the conversation as User A — the online indicator should no longer appear
items.notes: Presence is polled from /api/presence. lastSeenAt is updated every 60 s.

items.title: Progress — dashboard overview tab
steps: From the home screen tap 'Progress'
Verify the 'Dashboard' tab is active by default
Check that total sessions, current streak, and intensity points are displayed
Verify a gamification tier badge (e.g. Bronze / Silver) appears based on session count
Mini charts (sessions over time, intensity trend) should be visible
Verify the data matches actual workout logs in the DB

items.title: Progress — exercises tab (per-exercise history)
steps: Open Progress → 'Exercises' tab
A list of exercises you have logged at least once should appear
Tap an exercise — a detail view or expanded section should show all logged sets (date, weight, reps)
Verify the personal best weight and reps are highlighted
Verify the muscle diagram shows the primary muscles for the selected exercise

items.title: Progress — history tab (session log)
steps: Open Progress → 'History' tab
A chronological list of past sessions should appear with date, day title, and duration
Tap a session to see details — sets logged for each exercise should be visible
Verify the most recent session is at the top

items.title: Progress — body tab (metrics tracking)
steps: Open Progress → 'Body' tab
Verify weight and body-fat charts are displayed
Tap '+ Log weight' — enter a weight and tap Save
Verify the new data point appears on the weight chart
Repeat for body fat percentage
Verify goal lines appear on the chart if targetWeightKg or targetBodyFatPct are set in the profile

items.title: Body metrics — trend chart accuracy
steps: Log at least 5 body-weight entries across different dates
Open the Body tab — the BodyTrendChart should show all points correctly scaled
Verify the Y-axis labels reflect min/max of the data range
Verify date labels on the X-axis are readable
If a goal weight is set, a dashed goal line should be visible on the chart

items.title: Push notifications — browser subscribe flow
steps: Open the app in a supported browser (Chrome/Edge/Firefox on Android or desktop)
Grant notification permission when prompted (or manually from Settings)
Verify /api/push/subscribe is called and a PushSubscription row is created in the DB
Trigger a push test via /api/push/test — verify a push notification arrives on the device
Verify the notification shows the IRONLOG title
items.notes: Requires VAPID env vars. Not supported in Safari on iOS < 16.4.

items.title: PWA — install prompt + offline shell
steps: Open the app in Chrome on Android or desktop
The browser install prompt should appear (or be accessible via the address bar '⊕ Install')
Install the PWA — it should open as a standalone window with no browser chrome
Verify the app icon is correct and the splash screen shows the IRONLOG branding
Go offline — the app shell should still load (service worker cache)
Verify rest timer notifications still fire while the app is installed and backgrounded

items.title: Leaderboard — personal ranking (trainer's client list)
steps: Log in as a trainer with multiple clients who have workout logs
Open the leaderboard section on the trainer home screen
Verify clients are ranked by sessions by default
Toggle sort to streak and intensity — ranks update
Verify the logged-in trainer's own row is highlighted or labelled

items.title: Group leaderboards — create a group
steps: Log in as a trainer
Open the group leaderboards section on the home screen
Tap 'Create group'
Enter a group name and choose privacy (private/public)
Tap Create — the group should appear in 'MY LEADERBOARDS'
Verify a LeaderboardGroup row is created in the DB
items.notes: Added in commit 4098899.

items.title: Group leaderboards — invite members
steps: Open a group you created as a trainer
Tap 'Invite member' and enter a client's username
Tap 'Send invite'
Log in as the client — an invite notification should appear in the leaderboard invites section
Accept the invite
Return to the group as the trainer — the client should appear in the member list with their rank

items.title: Group leaderboards — MY CLIENTS search
steps: Log in as a trainer with ≥ 3 clients
Expand the 'MY CLIENTS' section on the home screen
Use the built-in search field to filter by partial username
Verify only matching clients are shown
Clear the search field — all clients reappear
Verify the collapsible state persists if you navigate away and return
items.notes: New feature in commit 4098899 — collapsible + search within MY CLIENTS.

items.title: Theme system — Iron / Mono / Vivid + accent colour
steps: Open Settings and scroll to the Theme section
Select 'Mono' theme — verify the UI switches to a monochrome palette
Select 'Vivid' theme — verify a colourful palette is applied

items.title: Admin panel — user management

items.notes:
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Fixed: user table now wrapped in horizontally-scrollable container (overflow-x: auto, touch momentum), so on narrow viewports the table scrolls inside its panel instead of breaking page layout. Page padding tightened for mobile.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Fixed: admin key input has the same eye toggle as the user-facing password fields.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Fixed: 'Force reset' button shipped on every user row. New PATCH action 'force-reset' flips mustResetPassword=true on the target user; their next login routes them through the must-reset screen. Button is disabled (and labelled 'Reset pending') if the user already has the flag set. Confirms with a browser confirm() dialog first.
[2026-05-21 523f873+] Not done by design: 'force-show-password'. Passwords are scrypt-hashed and not retrievable — even an admin can't recover them, only force a reset. This is a security feature, not a bug.
ADMIN_SECRET env var must be set. Route: /admin page.tsx + /api/admin.

items.title: QA dashboard (/qa) — admin view with threads, search, general notes
steps: Navigate to /qa while logged in — verify a single 'SIGNED IN AS @<your-username>' chip is shown (no name input)

Verify the General Notes card at the top is open by default and accepts comments

Verify the old BACKUP / RESTORE buttons are gone (no longer needed — comments save to the server)

Tap the teal '📤 OPEN IN BROWSER' chip in the dashboard header. In the installed PWA on iOS: verify the native share sheet appears (so you can pick 'Open in Safari'). In a regular browser tab: verify it opens /qa in a new tab. If neither works, verify it falls back to copying the URL to clipboard.
Verify the short helper line under the chips explains what each one does (📤 vs 🥋).
Each comment shows @username if the submitter was logged in
Verify each item card's status row shows TESTED ×N (count of comments) AND LAST <date hh:mm> (most recent of item.lastTested or newest comment ts)
Expand an item with a populated notes field — verify a 📜 PATCH HISTORY (count) section appears with each [date] entry rendered as its own row (date tag highlighted, body text in regular weight)
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Item card status row now shows TESTED ×N · LAST <date time> instead of the previous date-only `Last tested:`. Latest activity is computed as max(item.lastTested, newest comment ts) so fresh feedback moves the line forward before the next QA pass. The notes blob is now rendered as a 📜 PATCH HISTORY list — each `[date]` line becomes its own row with the date tag highlighted in red, body in regular weight.
[2026-05-21] Slice 2/N (PWA escape, real this time): the previous `<a target=_blank>` to /qa stayed trapped in the iOS PWA's in-app webview. Switched to a button that calls navigator.share() first — on iOS PWA the native share sheet appears with 'Open in Safari', which is the only reliable escape path. Falls back to window.open() (Android PWA + desktop), then clipboard copy (last resort).
[2026-05-21] Cleanup: removed the BACKUP / RESTORE buttons (server-side comment save makes them unnecessary). Tester name input now auto-fills + hides when the visitor is logged in.

items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Slice 2/N: rubric tightened per user feedback — status, screenshot and 'processed' bonuses are now gated behind verification (the comment must be marked processed by Claude). isValidScreenshotUrl() rejects empty/non-http/malformed URLs so a screenshot field still has to be a real URL even when processed. Note-detail cap raised from +5 to +15 (rate stays 0.05/char). Leaderboard row now shows a ⧗ pending chip so testers can see what's awaiting verification.
[2026-05-21] Slice 1/N: shipped the client-side leaderboard component in app/qa/page.tsx. Aggregates from already-loaded QAComment rows (no new endpoint). Rendered with rank medals, breakdown chips, and an expandable rubric. Future slices (if requested): per-user trend over time, all-time vs this-week toggle, server-side aggregation if comment volume gets large.

items.title: QA coverage sweep — qa:scan script + CLAUDE.md rule
steps: Run `npm run qa:scan` from the repo root — verify it scans the 10 most recent feature/pass sections in PATCHLOG.md

Open CLAUDE.md — verify the 'Every shipped feature MUST have a qa-state.json item' section is present and documents the workflow
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Bumped scan window from 5 to 10 most-recent feature/pass sections so more of the recent history is covered each run.
[2026-05-21] Shipped scripts/qa-scan.ts + the `qa:scan` npm script + CLAUDE.md convention rule. The script is informational by default (warnings don't fail) and strict on demand (`--strict` makes everything an error, suitable for CI later).

items.title: QA mascot splash — DOPPO the Baki-style QA sensei
steps: Open /qa in a fresh tab (or clear sessionStorage key `qa-doppo-seen-v1`)

Verify the full-screen mascot splash appears with a red vignette, animated speed-lines backdrop, and either the Doppo PNG OR the 🥋 'DOPPO IS TRAINING' placeholder if /public/qa-mascot.png isn't uploaded yet
Verify the manga speech bubble at the bottom types out 4-5 lines of Baki-style dialogue character-by-character
Verify the dialogue is personalized to your leaderboard state: rank #1 gets a different speech than rank #3, zero comments gets a different speech than veteran
Tap mid-dialogue — verify it skips to the end of the script (TAP TO SKIP label)
Tap again after dialogue completes — verify the splash dismisses (TAP TO ENTER label)
Reload /qa in the same session — verify the splash does NOT re-appear (sessionStorage-gated)
Tap the 🥋 SUMMON DOPPO button next to the QA Dashboard title — verify the splash re-opens
Drop a transparent PNG at /public/qa-mascot.png and reload — verify the placeholder is replaced by the real mascot art
Verify the splash does not block scrolling or interaction once dismissed
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Slice 2/N (Doppo fixes): (a) the prior 'fix' added `user: { select: ... }` to the prisma findMany, but QAComment has no schema @relation to User — at runtime that throws and returns 500, which is why the dashboard showed 0 counts and Doppo greeted everyone as STRANGER (the comments array stayed empty). Replaced with a manual batched user enrichment: fetch distinct userIds → batched user lookup → merge in the route handler. No schema migration risk. (b) Speech-bubble grew line-by-line during the typewriter, pushing the mascot upward — fixed by reserving vertical space for every line in the chosen arc upfront via `minHeight: calc(N * 1.55em + (N-1)*4px)` on the dialogue container. Mascot now stays anchored. Bumped sessionStorage key to qa-doppo-seen-v3 so every active session sees the correct greeting + layout.
[2026-05-21] Slice 1/N: shipped MascotSplash.tsx + integration in app/qa/page.tsx. Component is sessionStorage-gated and re-summonable via a chip in the dashboard header. Image is loaded from /public/qa-mascot.png with an onError fallback to a placeholder card so the splash is functional before the art lands. Dialogue picker has 5 arcs based on rank/bugs/comments.

items.notes: [2026-05-21] Schema: User.extraRoles String[] @default([]) — Vercel auto-runs prisma db push on deploy. Auth GET returns the field. New userHasRole(user, name) helper checks both primary role and the extras array; all trainer-feature gates in app/page.tsx updated to use it. Admin GET/PATCH endpoints expose the new field and a set-extra-roles action. The /admin UI shows per-user toggle chips for granting/revoking extras.

items.title: App version + manual 'Check for updates' in Settings
steps: Open Settings — verify a '🔄 APP VERSION' card sits above SEND FEEDBACK
Verify the card shows 'You're running v1.0.N' as the big line (friendly semver) and a small 'build <sha7>' line below it
Tap 'CHECK FOR UPDATES' — verify it shows '✓ YOU'RE ON THE LATEST · v1.0.N' when no new deploy happened

Push a no-op commit + wait ~1 min for Vercel to deploy → return to the open Settings tab without reloading, tap CHECK FOR UPDATES again — verify the red 'New version available' panel appears with both v1.0.N labels (old vs new) and a 🔄 REFRESH NOW button
Tap REFRESH NOW — verify the page reloads and the running version matches the latest. In the installed PWA, verify the service worker kicks an update before the reload
items.notes:
[2026-05-21] Slice 3/N: REFRESH NOW button no longer leaves the iOS PWA on a black screen until the user swipes. Replaced location.reload() with a location.replace() to the same URL + a `?_v=<timestamp>` cache-bust query — iOS treats that as a fresh navigation which renders cleanly, instead of the in-place reload which can leave the page suspended until a touch event. Also: the refresh now sends SKIP_WAITING to any waiting SW so the new bundle activates immediately, and public/sw.js gained a message handler that calls self.skipWaiting() when it receives that message.
[2026-05-21] Slice 2/N: friendly user-facing version label `v1.0.N` derived from PATCHLOG section count.
[2026-05-21] Slice 1/N: shipped /api/version + Settings card.
